home.floatingStatBody: Instant PDF, emailed to both parties
home.howItWorksTitle: From wizard to signed contract in four steps
home.howItWorksSubtitle: A streamlined flow built for Quebec construction professionals — no legal jargon, no paperwork.
home.step1Body: Tell us your role, the other party's details, the project scope, and the payment terms. Profile data prefills automatically.
home.step2Body: We assemble a Quebec-law-compliant contract in your chosen language, with the C.C.Q. holdback and RBQ clauses included.
home.step3Body: $99 CAD per contract, or unlimited at $349 / month with Pro. Stripe-secure checkout, no card data stored on our side.
home.step4Body: Your PDF is emailed instantly and stays in your dashboard. Print, sign, share — done.
home.whyTitle: Built specifically for Quebec construction work
home.whyBody: Generic contract generators don't speak French, don't reference the Civil Code of Québec, and don't handle GST + QST correctly. We do all three by default.
home.feat1Body: Every clause, every email, every PDF — in both official languages. Toggle anywhere.
home.feat2Body: Holdback (art. 2111), governing law, RBQ licence number, hypothec waiver — all wired in.
home.feat3Body: Pick the correct incorporation regime per party. Reflected in signature blocks and tax fields.
home.feat4Body: From the last wizard step to a downloadable PDF in under 10 seconds. Server-side rendering only.
home.feat5Body: Both you and the other party receive the contract and a Quebec-compliant receipt with GST + QST broken out.
home.feat6Body: We never see your card data. Webhooks confirm every payment with idempotency safeguards.
home.plan2Feat4: Cancel anytime, access until period end
home.faq1Q: Is this a substitute for a lawyer?
home.faq1A: No. ConstrAction Inc. provides automated document generation tools and does not offer legal advice, legal opinions, or legal representation. We strongly recommend reviewing every generated contract with a licensed Quebec lawyer before signing.
home.faq2Q: Are the contracts compliant with Quebec law?
home.faq2A: Our templates reference the Civil Code of Québec (notably art. 2111 for the construction holdback), the RBQ licence framework, and Quebec's Charte de la langue française. They are designed for Quebec — not generic Canadian or U.S. boilerplate.
home.faq3Q: Do you charge GST and QST?
home.faq3A: Yes. All prices on the site are pre-tax. At checkout, we apply 5% GST and 9.975% QST independently (not compounded), and the breakdown appears on every receipt.
home.faq4Q: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
home.faq4A: Yes — cancellations take effect at the end of the current billing cycle. You keep Pro access until that date, then automatically switch back to pay-per-contract. No refunds for partial periods (see Refund Policy).
home.finalCtaTitle: Ready to generate your first contract?
home.finalCtaBody: No credit card required to try the wizard. Pay only when you're ready to download the PDF.
